clue.text: Eg Dull and Boring tunes oddly enthral women in drag

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A drag act performs strange songs that captivate the audience.
explanation.walkthrough: Dull (a village in Scotland) and Boring (Oregon, USA) really are paired, so the playful definition is literally true; 'enthral' means hold within.
explanation.definitionFit: Dull in Scotland and Boring in Oregon are paired as sister places, an example of a twinning arrangement.

clue.text: Brass behind in test broadcast

clue.text: With nous this band could become unionised

clue.text: On radio avoids Iolanthe's opening movements …

clue.text: An attempt at good showing of Patience? On the contrary

a go is an attempt or try

explanation.walkthrough: Patience is a Gilbert and Sullivan opera, but here the word means patience: being eager is the contrary, a show of impatience.

clue.text: … represented as sliding scales

explanation.definitionFit: A glissando is a rapid slide through a run of notes, so the plural is a set of sliding runs.

clue.text: Nothing, I guess, is too much for lively dances

clue.text: Clarinets and viola 17 in Candide, say

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Voltaire's Candide mocks optimistic philosophy through comic adventure, a classic example of a mocking work of fiction.

clue.text: Timeless tune of the French is intrusive and improper

explanation.definitionFit: Something unwarranted or excessive is inappropriate, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: When Times correspondents traditionally write piece by 20

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are the same phrase: the Delius tone poem's title and the occasion for a traditional letter.

clue.text: Paper's first critique of Eric and Ernie's version of André

explanation.definitionFit: In the Morecambe and Wise sketch, the comedians mangled the conductor Previn's surname into this word.

clue.text: Series put out about Schubert's Fourth and put out again

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Moving a piece of music into a different key is the musical sense of this word.

clue.text: Sacred books regularly occur in a happy 17

Scoring northeast choir medley's hard going

clue.text: Note quintet mostly played close to the end

clue.text: Overhear a Cherubini piece and suffer this?
